alternative-directions.alt: Three number lines for a proportion from 0.55 to 0.85, each with the null value 0.70 marked by a dot. First, alternative "p < 0.70": the values below 0.70 are highlighted. Second, alternative "p > 0.70": the values above 0.70 are highlighted. Third, alternative "p is not 0.70": the values on both sides of 0.70 are highlighted. The direction comes from the research question, before any data are seen.
